infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kin uses your location to find nearby food and movement options that fit your day. You can change this at any time.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kin uses your camera to estimate nutrition from a photo of your meal.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kin uses your photo library so you can analyze a meal photo you've already taken.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Kin can use your calendar to recommend options that fit your actual schedule.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Kin reads activity, sleep, and recovery data to personalize your recommendations.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Kin can log workouts and mindfulness sessions back to Apple Health.
